exact_decimal_intake.method: All JSON number tokens are wrapped before JSON.parse and converted from decimal lexemes to reduced BigInt rationals before row classification.

arithmetic_backend.endpoint_policy: exact rational lower and upper endpoints; row accepted only by strict rational interval disjointness

period_policy.note: This v3 sidecar treats the packet decimal T_cyc as the exact period token for time ranges and derivative time terms. The rational pi interval is used only for trigonometric enclosure of X_delta and dX_delta/dtheta, not as a replacement for the packet period token.

pi_certificate.method: Classical rational enclosure 333/106 < pi < 355/113 used as a conservative priority-side pi bracket for trig range enclosures.

trig_enclosure_method.argument_reduction: Normalize q modulo 1, reduce 2*pi*q to the nearest quarter-turn, and evaluate sine/cosine on a residual interval with |residual angle| <= pi/4.
trig_enclosure_method.remainder_bound: Absolute Taylor tail bounded by first omitted term divided by 1-r, where r <= M^2/((d+1)(d+2)) and M is the rational maximum absolute reduced angle.
trig_enclosure_method.subdivision_rule: Each mesh interval is split by uniform rational subdivisions plus phase-wrap, half-period, bump-support endpoint, and bump-maximum breakpoints before null-coordinate hulls are formed.
trig_enclosure_method.derivative_rule: Derivative enclosures split additionally at quarter-support bump derivative extrema and base sine extrema before hull formation.

x_delta_definition.bump_formula: psi_A(theta)=sin^2(pi*(theta-L_A)/(R_A-L_A)) on the support interval and zero outside

coefficients.proof_scope: Uses |cos| <= 1 and 0 <= psi_i <= 1 on first-half arcs, with half-period antisymmetry preserving the same absolute bound. This does not use trigonometric interval enclosures and therefore certifies only coarse time-separated range-empty rows.

x_bound_certificate.proof_scope: Uses |cos| <= 1 and 0 <= psi_i <= 1 on first-half arcs, with half-period antisymmetry preserving the same absolute bound. This does not use trigonometric interval enclosures and therefore certifies only coarse time-separated range-empty rows.

trig_enclosure_status: used_for_row_specific_range_empty rows and same-interval monotone diagonal exclusions only; simple-root and fold-layer certificates remain absent
